const data = $input.item.json;

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are an H&S compliance checker for Ashvale Civil Engineering.',
  'Analyse the Safety Culture inspection and return ONLY valid JSON — no markdown, no explanation.',
  '',
  'JSON schema:',
  '{',
  '  "puwer":        "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "loler":        "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "site_sup":     "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "xcavator":     "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "dumper":       "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "roller":       "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "telehand":     "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "havs":         "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "toolbox":      "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "rams":         "Y" | "N" | "N/A",',
  '  "note":         "string or empty string",',
  '  "note_severity": "critical" | "warning" | "none",',
  '  "warning_cells": ["list of keys to highlight yellow"]',
  '}',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- Y  = completed and compliant',
  '- N  = failed or issue found',
  '- N/A = equipment not present on site',
  '- warning_cells = keys where value is N or specific issue exists',
  '- note_severity: critical=serious breach (missing serials, checks not done, At Risk), warning=minor/incomplete, none=clear',
  '- note = one concise sentence or empty string'
].join('\n');

const claudeBody = JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-opus-4-7',
  max_tokens: 512,
  system: systemPrompt,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `INSPECTION DATA:\n${data.full_text}` }]
});

return [{ json: { ...data, _claudeBody: claudeBody } }];
